findings.evidence: `private abbrev compactForm` (line 56) and `private def lastUnitVector` (line 61) vs. public signatures at lines 66-68, 100-103, 142-151, 195-200.
findings.fix: Pick one vocabulary: either delete the private `compactForm`/`lastUnitVector`/`compactUnitLevel` wrappers and write `realCliffordForm (n+1) 0` / `Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1` throughout, or keep `lastUnitVector` as a public def used in the public statements with a named `@[simp]` unfolding lemma to rewrite with. Either way the `show … by rfl` and the wrapper-unfolding `simp only [compactForm, lastUnitVector]` steps disappear.
findings.issue: The public statements are phrased in `realCliffordForm (n + 1) 0` / `Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1` while every proof and private definition uses `compactForm` / `lastUnitVector`; the two vocabularies are linked only by unfolding. Sites: 110 (`simpa only [lastUnitVector] using hx`), 119, 130-131, 153, 177-178, 186-188 (`change` across the Spin carrier), 213 (`rw [show Pi.single (Fin.last n) (1 : ℝ) = lastUnitVector n by rfl]` — `lastUnitVector` is a non-reducible `private def`, so this is a delta-unfolding `rfl`), 217-218.

findings.evidence: Lines 152-153, 189-190, 206-208 all perform `rw [realCliffordSpinLastLocalSection]` + `simp only [hx, dite_true, localSectionOn]`.
findings.fix: In both proofs use `rw [realCliffordSpinLastLocalSection_apply x hx]` (for the continuity proof, follow with `coe_spinReflectionPair`) instead of `rw [realCliffordSpinLastLocalSection]; simp only [hx, dite_true, localSectionOn]`; this also removes the `change` at 186-188.
findings.issue: `realCliffordSpinLastLocalSection_apply` is the public equation lemma, but the continuity proof (lines 189-190) and the action proof (lines 206-208) both bypass it and re-unfold the definition plus the private `localSectionOn` and the `dite` themselves, duplicating the same three-step reasoning at three sites.

findings.evidence: Lines 227-242; `reflection_smul_eq` at TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/OrthogonalGroup.lean:431 carries a `let _ : Invertible (Q (a • v))` in its statement, which is the instance mismatch being papered over.
findings.fix: Add a named equation lemma (e.g. `realCliffordSpinLastLocalSectionDirection_eq_smul : realCliffordSpinLastLocalSectionDirection x = (Real.sqrt …)⁻¹ • (Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1 - -x) := rfl`), `rw` with it first, then apply `QuadraticMap.reflection_smul_eq` directly, supplying the instance with `Subsingleton.elim` only if one genuinely remains.
findings.issue: `hreflection` closes with `convert QuadraticMap.reflection_smul_eq … using 1; congr 1; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _`. This only works because `congr 1` sees through the delta-unfolding of `realCliffordSpinLastLocalSectionDirection` into `(sqrt …)⁻¹ • (…)` and happens to leave exactly one `Invertible` goal; the comment documents the reliance but does not remove it.

findings.evidence: Lines 120-122; `hsqrt : Real.sqrt (compactForm n …) ≠ 0` is already in context at line 111.
findings.fix: Close it explicitly: rewrite the form value as `Real.mul_self_sqrt hpos.le` (`√a * √a = a`, Mathlib/Analysis/Real/Sqrt.lean:149) and finish with `inv_mul_cancel₀ hsqrt`, so the step does not depend on `field_simp` output shape.
findings.issue: `field_simp` followed by `simpa [pow_two] using (Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le).symm` closes the normalization step by matching whatever normal form `field_simp` produced — fragile to any change in `field_simp` or in the `sq`/`pow_two` simp set.

summary: The section proofs are held together by definitional bridging between private wrappers (`compactForm`, `lastUnitVector`) and the public `realCliffordForm (n+1) 0` / `Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1` vocabulary, including a `rw [show … by rfl]`, a `change`, and a `convert … congr 1 … Subsingleton.elim`. Two proofs also re-unfold the `dite` and the private `localSectionOn` instead of using the public equation lemma.
